ARCHITECTURAL CINEMA / 52 SECONDS

AL MAR.
A 12-villa coastal development.

Creative direction, interior concept design & visual production
Samir El Khoury

An architectural film for AL MAR, a coastal residential development comprising 12 villas. Modeled in 3ds Max and rendered with V-Ray. Image enhancement and additional imagery using GPT, Nano Banana, and Seedream. AI-assisted animation using Kling and Seedance. Project-specific music created with Suno. Compositing, video editing, and music integration using Adobe After Effects and CapCut.
